svg.title: Privacy First Search Lab end-to-end workshop workflow
svg.desc: A complete workflow showing source PDFs and manifest entering a Docker sbx microVM, ingestion through Python and local Ollama embeddings into Qdrant and SQLite, and questions flowing through OpenCode and a read-only MCP server to cited evidence and a final local answer. Network policy blocks cloud egress.
svg.text: From local documents to cited answers — inside Docker sbx
One machine • one controlled boundary • no hosted model or vector database
separate Linux kernel · private filesystem · isolated network
Compose builds and runs the data stack
private data network · hardened containers · named volumes
✕ Hosted LLMs, external APIs, telemetry, arbitrary web access
